finalists.label: Systemic Sclerosis
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings, including dry, thickened skin with salt-and-pepper lesions on the face and interstitial lung disease.

finalists.label: Autoimmune Disorder
finalists.why: It is supported by elevated C-reactive protein and a weak positive Anti-Sm antibody, which are indicative of an autoimmune process.

finalists.label: Nephrotic Syndrome
finalists.why: It explains the low albumin and ascites, but it is not as comprehensive as Systemic Sclerosis in accounting for the patient's symptoms and findings.

frontier_selector.why: Systemic Sclerosis is chosen because it accounts for the most decisive findings, including the specific skin lesions, interstitial lung disease, and the presence of anti-Sm antibodies, which are more specific to this condition than the other finalists.
